questions.question: What does Psalm 100 call all the earth to do?
options: Bow down low before the LORD and humbly confess all your sins
Wait patiently upon the LORD and so renew your failing strength
Make a joyful noise to the LORD and serve him with gladness
Cry out aloud to the LORD and pour out before him your complaint
questions.answer: Make a joyful noise to the LORD and serve him with gladness

questions.question: With what are worshipers told to enter God's gates and courts?
The psalm declares the LORD is good and his steadfast love endures forever.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with _____!
Know that the LORD, he is God! It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people and the sheep of his _____.
